description: This Java class defines a collection of constant integer values representing column indices used in bulk import transactions within the Fineract project. It serves as a set of shared constants for referencing specific columns in transaction data import/export processes.

classes.name: TransactionConstants
classes.description: A final utility class containing constant indices for various transaction-related columns in bulk import data, preventing magic numbers and facilitating maintainability.

methods.name: TransactionConstants
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation of utility class.
